metadata.qualification_scope: Frozen author artifact Zenodo 11179594, AML org.metaborg:accmodlang:0.1.0; original SDF3/Statix/Stratego sources preserved. Eight SPT positive/negative cases check parsing, binding, unbound names, typing, visibility and shadowing. Freshly compiled API driver records exact Statix rule diagnostics and invokes upstream Stratego to generate Java; fresh javac and execution produce one=1 and answer=42. Workbench and AML binaries are not rebuilt; this is not an official Spoofax 2.5.23 distribution, Eclipse GUI, full research suite, or C#/Rust qualification.

runtime_toolchain.distribution: Shared pinned offline support runtime; Java and javac required; Maven/Gradle/Docker not required.

source_acquisition.retained_members: A self-contained AML runner, matching AML binary/source JARs, original AML grammar/Statix/Stratego/tests and provenance. The entire image is not retained.
